Ava Chen: Follow-up on last night's latency incident in ap-southeast-1. Need: one-line statuspage, a short customer summary, RCA redaction guidance, and clear remediation owners/timelines.

Jon Rivera: Draft statuspage copy: "We experienced a regional service degradation impacting inference latency in ap-southeast-1 for ~30 minutes. We applied traffic fallback and temporary cache TTL increases; full RCA and remediation plan forthcoming."

Priya Patel: Good. Compliance: redact vendor timestamps, internal IPs, and any debug tokens before publishing RCA. Offer customers a route to request more detail via support.

Samir Gupta: I'll own the cache TTL permanent change and a small autoscaler cooldown tune. Action ids: cache-fix-246 (ETA 36h), autoscale-tune-87 (ETA 72h). Will link PRs here when ready.

Marta Reyes: I'll draft a 2-paragraph customer summary (timeline + mitigations) and a mini-FAQ. Will post in #customer-comms for review by EOD.

Ava Chen: Owners recap: Jon -> publish statuspage (1h), Marta -> customer summary (EOD), Priya -> compliance pass (24h), Samir -> remediation PRs (36-72h). OpsBot, create checklist and reminder for 24h and schedule a pattern-review meeting next Wed.

OpsBot: Checklist created: [x] draft statuspage, [ ] publish statuspage, [ ] customer summary, [ ] compliance review, [ ] remediation PRs linked, [ ] schedule workshop. Reminders set for 1h and 24h.

Ava Chen: Noting this is the nth autoscaler/cache-related incident in recent months; add a recurring-pattern action to the postmortem. We'll review at the workshop. Ping with PR links and drafts here.
